paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Comparison of correlation between training loss (cross-entropy objective loss for Consistency-CE and Bi-objective loss for Consistency-Bi) and translation quality (BLEU score) on train subset of WMT15 De-En task for wait-k policy.
model_annotation: This line plot compares the correlation between training loss and translation quality, measured by BLEU score, for two different consistency methods—Consistency-CE and Consistency-Bi—across varying values of the testing parameter k on the WMT15 De-En task. The x-axis, labeled “testing k”, uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 9, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “Correlation”, uses a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 0.9, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The “Consistency-CE” method is represented by a blue dashed line with circle markers, starting at a correlation of approximately 0.62 when k=1 and rising to about 0.75 when k=9. The “Consistency-Bi” method is represented by an orange solid line with square markers, beginning at approximately 0.93 when k=1 and remaining nearly constant at around 0.95 for all values of k up to 9.
